newsitem.title: GERMANY: German building union-Govt cuts hit jobs growth.
newsitem.headline: German building union-Govt cuts hit jobs growth.

text.p: German construction union IG Bau said on Thursday that any attempts by the Bonn government to cut back on public construction programmes as part of its budget savings plan would have a negative effect on employment.

"Budgetary consolidation efforts by the government at the current stage in the economic cycle could have the opposite effect to their intended aims," IG Bau chairman Klaus Wiesehuegel said in a speech.
The simultaneous trend of lowering wages was hitting consumer demand, Wiesehuegel said, and he forecast a slow down in the building economy of three percent.
Wiesehuegel said he had no comment to make on employee demands on pay talks for 1997.
